_comment: Physical layer constants for SW-11. Data, not code (README section 3, item 7). Every number here is a stated programme assumption for a synthetic network; none is an empirical estimate for a named corridor or product. See docs/11_PHYSICS_LAYERS.md section 8.

queue._model: Kingman / Allen-Cunneen approximation for GI/G/c. Delay factor is a table so the decision path never evaluates a power or an exponential.

thermal._model: Newton cooling for the continuous curve (reporting) and a linear exposure budget for the gate. The linear budget is a conservative bound: a test asserts it never under-reports Arrhenius degradation.

traffic._model: LWR kinematic wave with a triangular fundamental diagram. Used to price congestion delay, not to decide release.

reliability._model: Series product of per-mode availability (MTBF / (MTBF + MTTR)). A backup mode turns a series link into a parallel link.

epidemic._model: SIR final-size relation, imported as an analogy for cascade saturation. Reporting only.

finance._model: Expected shortfall (CVaR) of the loss distribution. Reporting only.

service._model: Anti-gaming floor: a planner that defers everything cannot win on unsafe actions.

cost._model: Price list for compliance actions. Reported so that a reduction in unsafe actions is never free by construction.
